costs.cost_gate: No calibrated-cost or live qualification until matched account-scoped round-trip evidence is frozen independently of evaluation outcomes;3.74bp is not an empirical round-trip estimate.
costs.recorded_spread: Included once through executable bid/ask fills

frozen_candidate_hypothesis.economic_hypothesis: Conditional on same-sign5/20-session price trends and a same-direction historical sigma-band impulse, a50% retracement can offer a better remaining-session continuation opportunity than immediately chasing the impulse. Persistent order-flow/rebalancing is a proposed mechanism, not observed participant evidence; the macro input is technical price context only.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.entry: Freeze impulse midpoint; fixed50% retracement towards fresh opening midpoint, executable side touch on a later quote, reject origin overshoot. One attempt/session; no retry after macro veto or no retest.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.exit: Initial-1R stop; entry-price stop proposal at+1R applied on strictly later valid quote; gross+1.38R target rounded outward. Existing bracket priority. Primary horizon ends at native session open+4h with fresh<=5s forced close; separate strict bracket-exit anatomy. No72h continuation in the confirmatory score.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.falsification: Reject a general edge if independently reserved sessions fail positive stress-cost expectancy, if incremental C-versus-B returns vanish, or if apparent gains depend on one week/class, cheap unverified costs, censoring or data abstention.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.impulse: Existing native14-session sigma and half-hour marks; first admitted impulse; R>=48bp at decision and later fresh fill. Full spread+2*price*3.74bp C<R durable admission veto. Strictly later fresh executable dispatch within5s; no hindsight peak.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.initial_r: Ceil-to-grid(abs(entry-open_mid)+touch_spread+2*entry*3.74/10000), preserving cost-dependent tested geometry. This coupling is disclosed; a risk-independent redesign would be a different candidate.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.macro: At session open, last5 and20 completed coded-session drifts must strictly agree with impulse direction. Same-account same-date peer, when present, must have complete causal context and neither drift opposing. Missing peer context blocks; absent peer allowed and separately reported, matching Phase3.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.planned_peer_policy: All8 symbols are scheduled, so peers should be present. A failed planned peer is data failure, not permission to recategorise it as absent; no outcome-conditioned peer availability.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.primary_model: Phase3 tier1,48bp threshold,3.74bp/side admission; exactly preserve the tested full-M30 rule.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.sizing: Fixed native volumes from manifest for quote-path comparison only; no account Kelly/margin simulation or change to live risk limits.
frozen_candidate_hypothesis.source_mode: Full45-calendar-day coded-session M30 qualification; no Tier2 opening-range fallback. Historical broker calendars and contracts remain prerequisites, not inferred from missing bars.

limitations: 3.74bp is an assumption, not calibrated round-trip cost.
Tick discontinuities and native unqualified-return flags remain visible.
Tier2 is a separate opening-range diagnostic, not the frozen sigma candidate.
New-batch dates were already examined under a different candidate and do not match the original frozen independent weeks.
Combined prior outcomes are reused development evidence; do not count them as new independent wins.
original_frozen_candidate_tested_offline: At least one new-batch episode evaluated with exact Phase4 Tier1 rules; not a claim the independent date matrix or financial validation completed.
